desc: **Derive per-digit rules** (1/2/5, 4, 8, 3/6/9, 7) and document boundary cases for short prefixes
**Implement the full single-pass solution** (mod-3/9 prefix counters, mod-7 rolling table, per-digit dispatch, correct query/insert ordering, boundary handling at i=0,1)
**Test & verify**: hand-traced all three examples ("12936"→11, "5701283"→1+1+0+4+5+5+2=18, "1010101010"→25) and edge cases (i=0/1 boundaries for d=4/8, "0"→0, "7"→1)
**Performance check on n = 1e5**: single pass with a 7-element list rebuild per index (~O(7n) cheap ops) is well within limits; no need for the 6×7 prefix-bucket variant
